- [USER] User inquired about the current state of the cannabis industry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The legal cannabis industry in the US is expected to reach a value of $35 billion by 2025.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cannabis remains illegal on a federal level, complicating access to traditional banking and funding for companies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There is ongoing debate over regulatory issues, such as labeling and dosing requirements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The global market for cannabis products and services is expected to reach $194 billion worldwide by 2025.
- [USER] User asked if federal legalization of cannabis is on the horizon.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The possibility of federal legalization is a hot topic of debate among lawmakers, industry experts, and advocates.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Progress has been made with the passing of the SAFE Banking Act and the MORE Act, which would remove marijuana from the Controlled Substances Act.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It remains uncertain when or if cannabis will become federally legal.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Growing public support for legalization and potential economic benefits may catalyze further progress.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The regulatory framework for the cannabis industry is still relatively new and evolving.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cannabis being illegal at the federal level complicates the creation of a unified regulatory framework.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] State regulations vary widely, with some states having rigorous standards and others having fewer regulations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Many companies are investing in quality control measures, testing, and labeling their products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] More comprehensive regulations are likely to be put in place as the industry evolves.
